## `client.secrets`

The `secrets` resource of the platform API.

### `client.secrets.create`

Signature: `client.secrets.create(environment: str, name: str, values: dict[str, str], kind: str | None = None, target: str | None = None) -> Secret`

Create a secret.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment this secret is scoped to. |
| `name` | `str` | required | The secret's name, unique within its environment. |
| `values` | `dict[str, str]` | required | The plaintext key-value bag to encrypt and store. Sent only in the request body — never echoed back in any response, and never held by the SDK afterward. |
| `kind` | `str | None` | `None` | What the secret is for, so that it is bound as it is created: ``package_index``, ``repository`` or ``environment``. `None` leaves it unbound. |
| `target` | `str | None` | `None` | The index's or repository's name; `None` for the environment. |

Returns: `Secret`. The created secret's metadata.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the environment, or the named index or repository, does not exist. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If a secret of this name already exists in this environment. |

### `client.secrets.list`

Signature: `client.secrets.list(environment: str) -> list[Secret]`

List an environment's active secrets.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment whose secrets to list. |

Returns: `list of Secret`. Every active secret in this environment.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the environment does not exist. |

### `client.secrets.bind`

Signature: `client.secrets.bind(environment: str, name: str, kind: str, target: str | None = None) -> Secret`

Bind a secret to the one use it may serve.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment the secret is scoped to. |
| `name` | `str` | required | The secret's name. |
| `kind` | `str` | required | ``package_index``, ``repository``, ``connection`` or ``environment``. A connection's secret becomes the one the connection uses. |
| `target` | `str | None` | `None` | The index's, repository's or connection's name; `None` for the environment. |

Returns: `Secret`. The bound secret's metadata.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the environment, the secret or the target does not exist. |
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | If the caller may not manage secrets in the environment. |
